derivation.archive_policy: Do not infer or assert a DOI for archive-only records. Preserve archive and TeX hashes, content status, and source quality flags.
derivation.classification_policy: Versioned token-boundary rules retain only labels with a stored rule, field, matched span, confidence, and completed review status.
derivation.evidential_boundary: Summaries and routing labels support discovery only. They are not peer review, replication, empirical validation, or evidence of an ASI or phase transition.
derivation.repository_link_policy: Extract DOI relations from each pinned root README and classify the local context as implements, companion_software, cites, or lineage. Keep paper-index-external DOIs as external citations and never infer new paper records.
derivation.summary_policy: Extract the first sentence of the catalog abstract and truncate only at a word boundary when it exceeds 480 characters.

catalog_records_not_in_papers_config.title: OASG: Observable-only Autonomic Slack Gradient Theory

paper_selection.selection_rule: Canonical skill records are exactly the rows released in the papers configuration; archive-only records are exactly the rows released in the archive_only configuration.

derivative_exclusions.name: asi-proxy-phase-skill
derivative_exclusions.reason: This repository is the derived skill itself, not an upstream research source.

public_repositories.pin_policy: Each record uses the public repository default branch and its full HEAD SHA.
public_repositories.semantic_review_policy: Repository summaries, roles, interfaces, dimensions, maturity, dependencies, and eligibility carry pinned commit/path evidence. They remain navigation aids rather than empirical effect estimates.
